top_stories.title: Rajya Sabha polls: Only 4 BJP candidates in fray, party eyes clean sweep | Ahmedabad News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: **BJP** candidates Raju Shukla, Mukesh Rathva, Mansinh Parmar, and Jitendra Kanzariya filed their nominations for the four Rajya Sabha seats in Gujarat on Monday.  The ruling party is expected to sweep the election uncontested as only four nominations were submitted by the deadline of June 8th. The scrutiny of the nomination papers will take place on June 9th, with the final results announced on June 11th. **Chief Minister Bhupendra Patel**, **Deputy CM Harsh Sanghavi**, state party president **Jagdish Vishwakarma**, and state organizing secretary **Ratnakar** were among those present during the nominations filing.  The election for these seats is being held due to the end of the six-year term of four Rajya Sabha MPs, including Congress leader **Shaktisinh Gohil**.

top_stories.title: Israel-Iran Strikes Resume: 3 Major Takeaways From Latest Escalation
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Iran** and **Israel** resumed direct strikes on each other's territories after a ceasefire agreement, escalating tensions in the region.  **Donald Trump**, US President, called for an immediate ceasefire and stated that "final negotiations" were proceeding. The attacks followed **Iran**'s assertion that it would not engage in peace talks with the US until **Israel** ceased its actions in Lebanon. This escalation complicates efforts to achieve a ceasefire in Lebanon, while also raising concerns about the future of US-brokered peace negotiations and regional stability.  The events highlight the challenges facing both **Trump** and **Netanyahu**, who are facing elections later this year.

top_stories.title: Naga man killed by armed miscreants in Kangpokpi forest | India News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: A **Rongmei Naga** man, 58-year-old Chungjanglung Panmei, was killed by armed miscreants in Kangpokpi district of Manipur while collecting firewood. The incident occurred around 6:40 am on Monday when a group of villagers from Pongringlong Part-I were attacked. **Pongringlong Youth Club**, a local Rongmei Naga body, and the **village authority** stated that Panmei was killed by Kuki militants in Kangpokpi forests.  The police launched a rescue operation and recovered his body with four bullet injury marks.

top_stories.title: Bhagwant Singh surplus land case: Ambala officer cancels mutation of 810 acres | Chandigarh News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Sanjeev Verma**, **Ambala Divisional Commissioner**, has ordered the cancellation of land mutations in seven Panchkula villages, totaling over 810 acres. The land, valued at Rs 5,000 crore, belonged to **Sardar Bhagwant Singh**, an erstwhile king, and is now being transferred to the state government. This decision follows years of legal proceedings regarding the ownership of the estate, which has been disputed for decades.

top_stories.title: ‘Confident of high growth in Q1 despite elevated energy prices’ | Business News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: Despite elevated energy prices due to the war in West Asia, **the Indian government** is confident that the economy continues to perform well.  The high growth seen in January-March has spilled over into the new fiscal year, with data showing strong industrial growth and increased GST collections from imports. The government is taking steps to attract foreign capital, including tax cuts for foreign institutional investors (FIIs) investments in government bonds, aiming to boost India's inclusion in the Bloomberg Global Aggregate Bond Index.  The **Reserve Bank of India** has lowered its GDP growth forecast for 2026-27 but acknowledges the government's efforts to mitigate pressures on the economy.

top_stories.title: India’s current account surplus narrows to $7.1 billion in Q4 | Business News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: **India’s** current account surplus narrowed to $7.1 billion in the fourth quarter of 2025-26, down from $13.7 billion a year earlier.  Factors contributing to this decline include rising gold imports and foreign investor outflows. **The Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** reported that while the current account remained in surplus territory, the lower figure reflects reduced external earnings compared to the previous year. Net invisibles receipts increased significantly due to higher net services earnings and stronger remittances.

top_stories.title: Rajya Sabha polls: M.P. Congress mulls moving MLAs away as BJP fields candidate on third seat - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)**'s Mahesh Kewat entered the race for one of three Rajya Sabha seats in **Madhya Pradesh**, following the announcement of his candidacy on Sunday. The move prompted the Congress to consider moving its MLAs to other states, while the party's leader of opposition, **Umang Singhar**, hosted a dinner meeting with MLAs and senior leaders to discuss election strategy.  The Congress candidate, **Meenakshi Natarajan**, is backed by all her party members and sees this as a battle between "Gandhian ideology" and the BJP's "divisive politics."

top_stories.title: Mamata Banerjee, TMC: How one of India's most successful female politicians is losing her party
top_stories.rephrased_article: The Trinamool Congress (TMC), led by Mamata Banerjee, is experiencing a significant internal crisis following its loss in the recent West Bengal elections.  Banerjee's party has faced a rebellion from many of its legislators and MPs, who have accused her and her nephew of corruption and forging signatures on legislative documents. This has resulted in several TMC members seeking to align with the BJP-led ruling alliance. Political analysts suggest that this is part of a broader trend of regional parties becoming more centralized and family-centric, making them vulnerable after losing power. Banerjee remains defiant, but the future of the party remains uncertain.

top_stories.title: SpaceX's stock market blast-off could be Musk's biggest gamble yet
top_stories.rephrased_article: SpaceX, led by Elon Musk, is launching its initial public offering (IPO) of shares. The company's valuation has soared to $1.75 trillion, making it one of the most valuable companies on Earth.  Musk's ambitious vision for space exploration and artificial intelligence, including plans for a multiplanetary future and data centers in space, fuels investor interest. However, concerns remain about the control Musk will exert over the company and potential risks associated with investing in this rapidly evolving sector.
